title: Mozart's The Magic Flute premieres in Vienna
summary: Mozart's opera The Magic Flute, with a libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder, premiered at the Theater auf der Wieden. Mozart conducted.
reason: Schikaneder's popular theatre wanted a German language opera mixing comedy, fantasy and Masonic ideals.
significance: It became one of the most performed operas in the world.
place: Theater auf der Wieden, Vienna, Austria
